$description: Lane A supplement — carries the runbook-required token categories the canon interchange file lacks (CSS-function exclusion verified in delta-table.md §3): fluid clamp() spacing + type scale, breakpoint dimensions, clean motion. Values are strings; CSS passthrough keeps clamp/oklch strings verbatim. Every token has $type. Aliases use {group.name} syntax. Merged by tier-emitter.mjs — supplement wins only for names canon lacks.

base.$description: Alias to canon root size p31.base (16px). Cross-source {group.name} reference → emitted as var(--p31-base).

xs.$description: Fluid spacing xs — 12→16px @16px root. rem in preferred term (WCAG F94), ratio 1.33 ≤ 2.5×.

sm.$description: Fluid spacing sm — 16→20px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.25.

md.$description: Fluid spacing md — 20→28px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.40.

lg.$description: Fluid spacing lg — 28→36px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.29.

xl.$description: Fluid spacing xl — 36→48px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.33.

2xl.$description: Fluid spacing 2xl — 48→72px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.50.

3xl.$description: Fluid spacing 3xl — 72→108px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.50.

caption.$description: Fluid type caption — 11→13px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.18.

label.$description: Fluid type label — 12→14px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.17.

body.$description: Fluid type body — 14→16px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.14.

h3.$description: Fluid type h3 — 16→20px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.25.

h2.$description: Fluid type h2 — 20→26px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.30.

h1.$description: Fluid type h1 — 26→34px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.31.

display.$description: Fluid type display — 34→48px. rem in preferred term, ratio 1.41.

instant.$description: Duration instant — matches canon p31.duration-instant value.

fast.$description: Duration fast — design-core src/tokens/motion.ts canonical fast.

normal.$description: Duration normal — design-core src/tokens/motion.ts canonical normal.

slow.$description: Duration slow — matches canon p31.duration-slow value.

smooth.$description: Easing smooth — M3 standard; identical to canon p31.easing-standard [0.4,0,0.2,1].

snappy.$description: Easing snappy — overshoot ease, design-core tokens.json snappy.

speedFactor.$description: Motion speed multiplier — spoon ladder derives from this. (Numeric $value for a numeric $type — valid DTCG; CSS-function strings stay strings.)

page.$description: Page gutter — semantic alias to fluid.space.xl. Emits var(--p31-fluid-space-xl).

card-gap.$description: Card grid gap — semantic alias to fluid.space.md.

card-pad.$description: Card inner padding — semantic alias to fluid.space.lg.
